Disposition of prior blocks/amendments:
1. PTS and DTS are independently present or missing; every present value retains signed native tick plus exact timebase. Edition uses a playback axis, not playback-PTS.
2. Unknown zero duration is stated specifically for AVPacket/packet duration.
3. Segment coalescing requires contiguous collinear restrictions of the same exact affine function, same mapping family and directed source/target roles, same occurrence, no gap/hold/epoch/discontinuity seam, and compatible half-open semantics. Equal slope alone never suffices.
4. Mapping family, axis identity, canonical mapping-relation identity, and derivation-receipt identity remain distinct; courts mutate family, intercept, seam, and receipt separately.
5. Historical notes §120.6 still say weightless PySceneDetect exactly as recorded; §121 explicitly records the later learned-checkpoint-free ContentDetector terminology correction.
6. Exact-rational, quantized/enclosing, gap, outside-domain, no-correspondence, ambiguous, and arithmetic/quantization refusal are distinct total projection outcomes. Refusal may not be relabelled missing, gap, outside-domain, no-correspondence, or ambiguity; the court mutates this explicitly.

This remains a documentation-only pre-C1 contract. It admits no package, media, checkpoint, provider, runtime, or implementation. Please review these exact bytes only. I will not mutate them again without publishing a new hash and superseding this target.
